body.x: ABLE Labs(CEO Shin Sang) participated in CES 2024 held in Las Vegas, USA, from January 9th (Tuesday) to 12th (Friday, local time).

Dedicated to innovating the field of life sciences through cutting-edge automation solutions that enhance efficiency, precision, and reproducibility in laboratory workflows, ABLE Labs showcased its flagship product, ‘NOTABLE.’

NOTABLE is an automated liquid-handling robot designed and developed by ABLE Labs to meet the evolving demands of the life science and bio-research industries. This automation solution addresses manual pipetting and liquid handling challenges in laboratory experiments. According to the company, NOTABLE excels in aspirating and distributing small volumes with high precision, enhancing reproducibility and efficiency in various biological experiments.
The development of NOTABLE involved a comprehensive and iterative process that combined expertise in robotics, bioinformatics, and laboratory workflow.

body.cap: Liquid Handling Robot ‘NOTABLE’ │Photo provided by ABLE Labs

body.x: The critical stages of the development process included:
* Evaluation of research and requirements: Understanding challenges researchers face in liquid handling and identifying needs for a comprehensive automation solution.
* Design, features, and functionality brainstorming and conceptualization to meet identified requirements for NOTABLE.
* Prototyping of hardware and software components of the liquid handling robot, testing, and improvement.
* Collaborative user testing with researchers, collecting feedback, and iteratively improving the system for optimal usability and performance.

Subsequent stages involved implementing strict quality assurance measures to ensure NOTABLE’s reliability, accuracy, and safety in diverse laboratory environments. The robot was then released to the market, and continuous monitoring of user feedback led to updates, improvements, and new features.

NOTABLE’s key features include precision and accuracy, high-throughput automation, end-to-end workflow automation, flexibility and adaptability, user-centric UI/UX design, data connectivity and integration, cross-platform compatibility, compact and efficient design, predictive maintenance, and support for enhanced reproducibility, and cost-effectiveness.

ABLE Labs stated, “Based on a passion for automation and a vision for the future of bio experiments, ABLE Labs is at the forefront of leading a new era that accelerates the pace of scientific innovation through technology.”
